info.name: M30 - Payroll Engine + Pay Runs + Payslips
info.description:
API collection for M30 (ROADMAP) — Pay Components, Payroll Adjustments, Pay Runs (DRAFT→APPROVED→PAID), Pay Slips.

Note: This milestone was previously tracked as M26 in internal AI_STATUS due to a 4-number offset from ROADMAP from M10 onward. ROADMAP.md is now the authoritative numbering source.

Prerequisites:
- POST /api/auth/login to capture {{accessToken}}
- Ensure {{branchId}} is set (from /api/me)
- Ensure {{employeeId}} is set (from /api/hr/employees)

Manual Checklist:
1. Login as owner — capture accessToken
2. Set branchId env variable from /api/me
3. Get an employeeId from GET /api/hr/employees
4. Run requests in folder order: Components → Adjustments → Pay Runs → Pay Slips
5. Verify Build Pay Run returns status DRAFT with paySlips array
6. Verify Approve transitions to APPROVED and payslips become FINAL
7. Verify Pay transitions to PAID with postingPayload present
8. Verify Get Pay Slip shows componentSnapshot with basePay, grossPay, netPay
9. Verify pay-before-approve returns 400
10. Verify approve-twice returns 400
11. Verify Chef role returns 403 on all write endpoints
12. Verify GET /api/payroll/payslips/:id returns same data as /slips/:id

exec: pm.test('grossTotal is string (Decimal safety)', () => pm.expect(typeof body.grossTotal).to.eql('string').or.pm.expect(typeof body.grossTotal).to.eql('number'));
